whoFor: Family-owned businesses and their owners planning how leadership and ownership will pass on.

benefits.title: Continuity
benefits.text: A plan for who leads and who owns, agreed before it is urgent.

benefits.title: Fewer disputes
benefits.text: Expectations discussed and written down with the family.

benefits.title: Next leaders prepared
benefits.text: Development steps for the people who will take over.

whatYouReceive: Facilitated discussions with the owners and family members you choose
A written succession plan with stages and owners
A list of documents and filings the plan will need
whatYouProvide: The owners' goals and timing preferences
Information on the ownership and current roles
Participation from the family members involved
doesNotInclude: Tax advice on the transfer, which is scoped separately
